evidence: The paper mentions random forests only in the context of probability estimation: "the propensity scores and conditional outcome probabilities were estimated using random forests implemented with the R package ranger using default values for parameter tuning." Covariate selection strategies studied are stepwise selection (based on AIC) and univariable pre-filtering (based on p-values), not random forest variable importance. The paper concludes that "variables selected based on the underlying causal structure" matter for causal inference, not data-driven selection.
